basic_info.description: Welcome to One Mission Bay Park 306. This chic 2 bed/2 bath + den split floorplan blends contemporary finishes with sweeping views, creating a serene escape from the city. Hardwood floors span throughout the living areas, while lush carpet in the bedrooms adds warmth and comfort. Custom closets offer plenty of storage. The kitchen features modern sleek cabinetry, Caesarstone countertops, and high-end Gaggenau appliances. Enjoy year-round comfort with central heat and A/C, plus the convenience of in-unit laundry and 1-car parking. One Mission Bay offers residents the height of luxury living. As the last condo building built directly on the channel, it provides some of the best views and park access in the area, overlooking both the water and ORACLE Park. Amenities include a 24-hour doorperson, heated outdoor pool, resident dining and lounge areas, large terrace with fire pit, cabana, barbecues, and outdoor dining, state-of-the-art fitness center, business center and library with private meeting rooms, and a reservable guest suite. Be at the center of it all!
